title: ShopCoach's instructions can be checked before release, model recorded
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A QA environment where the ShopCoach brief and model can be changed; a fixed set of inspections with known findings. AUTOMATION note: brief/model verification is a developer/automated check - by hand, confirm only the observable outputs.
custom_steps:
1. Run the fixed set of known-finding inspections through the brief and read the drafted lines back: every flagged finding represented, no line inventing an ungiven part, no passing finding becoming a line.
2. Confirm the verification pass records the brief and the model together.
3. Confirm the brief and model can be changed on the QA environment without a release, so the pass can iterate.
4. Confirm the model choice is made and compared outside this epic and does not gate this work.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The brief is verifiable before release by running a fixed set of known-finding inspections through it and reading the drafted lines back: every flagged finding represented, no line inventing a part it was not given, and no passing finding becoming a line.
  • The model the brief runs on is specified, and the verification pass records the brief and the model together, because the output cannot be attributed to the brief alone.
  • The brief and the model can be changed on the QA environment without a release, so the verification pass can iterate.
  • Which model the brief runs on is chosen and compared outside this epic; this story only requires that the model is recorded with the brief, and the choice must not gate this work.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-R17: “The brief will be verifiable before release. A fixed set of inspections with known findings will be run through it and the drafted lines read back against them, checking that every flagged finding is represented, that no line invents a part it was not given, and that no passing finding became a line. Without that pass the brief is a guess: an assistant's output cannot be asserted the way a deterministic one can, so the only way to know a brief works is to try it on known input”
  • S15-R22: “The model the brief runs on is part of what is specified. The verification pass will record the brief and the model together, because the output cannot be attributed to the brief alone”
  • S15-R23: “The brief and the model will be changeable on the QA environment without a release, so the verification pass can iterate”
  • S15-R25: “The model the brief runs on is chosen and compared outside this epic. This story specifies that the model is recorded with the brief (S15-R22), not which model it is, and the choice must not gate this work”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
